For years I thought successful people were simply more motivated than everyone else.

Then I realised motivation is probably the least reliable thing to depend on.

Some days you wake up full of energy. Most days you don't.

The biggest improvements in my life didn't come from huge bursts of effort. They came from doing something small even when I couldn't be bothered.

Ten push-ups.

A twenty-minute walk.

Reading five pages instead of none.

Writing one page instead of waiting for inspiration.

Momentum beats motivation every time.

I'm curious—what habit has had the biggest impact on your life, even though it seemed too small to matter at the time?
